items.title: Guia definitivo: Saiba qual versão do Gemini você realmente deve usar
items.pt:
Frequentemente, o Google anuncia novos modelos de IA do Gemini. Com tantas opções, fica difícil acompanhar as novidades, as diferenças entre as IAs e, principalmente, qual é a mais indicada para cada tarefa. 
Se a ideia é corrigir um texto ou escrever um e-mail, por exemplo, um modelo mais leve pode resolver a tarefa. Mas, se você precisa analisar documentos extensos, programar ou resolver problemas complexos, vale recorrer a uma opção com maior capacidade de raciocínio.
Por isso, sempre utiliza

items.title: Payroll
items.pt:
We all love getting paid.

It's normal. It's expected. We're not there for the subsidised coffee. We work for money because we need to live.

People need food, shelter, cars, and holidays. We tie our income to our financial security. Our financial security is tied to our mental health.

Somewhat.

We don't really think about payroll, but imagine it's late. We will then. We'll also think about it every month thereafter.

items.title: Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
items.pt: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. items.title: EgoGeneralist: Unifying Egocentric Action-Video Tasks through Video-Native Modeling
items.pt: Modern video models possess strong visual priors, yet do not natively represent human action in metric 3D space. We present EgoGeneralist, which adapts pretrained video generators to unify action-conditioned egocentric video generation, pose estimation, and joint action-video generation. Our role-adaptive action renderer provides video-native representations for multidirectional action-video learning, making metric motion usable as both a spatial control signal and a recoverable generation targe

items.title: Towards interpreting any residual stream direction by scaling activation inversion
items.pt: To interpret a direction in a language model's residual stream, we can look for text that strongly activates it. But when such text is found by scanning a corpus, it is limited to what that corpus contains.
